results.title: Electro Mart, CEO Nurul Afser win four Commonwealth Business Excellence awards
results.description: Electro Mart, a manufacturer of Konka, Gree and Haiko electronics and home appliances in Bangladesh, and its Group Deputy Managing Director and CEO, Md Nurul Afser, received four awards at the fourth Commonwealth Business Excellence Awards 2026, held in London on 27 August 2026. The ceremony took place in the Conservatory Room of the Millennium Gloucester Hotel, Kensington, London.

results.title: SNAP bans led to 12% decline in soda purchases
results.description: Recipients didn’t buy more sugary drinks with their own dollars, bucking a common theory held across the food industry, a new academic study found.

results.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Class Action on Behalf of Innventure, Inc. Investors
results.description: LOS ANGELES, Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Portnoy Law Firm advises Innventure, Inc., (“Innventure” or the "Company") (NASDAQ: INV) investors of a class action on behalf of investors that bought securities between November 17, 2025 - August 13, 2026, inclusive (the “Class Period”). Innventure investors have until October 27, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.
